_comment: A scripted operator session that repairs a live run after an application
error, then hands control back so the automation finishes the job.
Scenario: the member detail screen returned MRDN-5001 while replay was
mid-flow. There is nothing on the error page for the automation to click,
so no locator strategy can resolve and it escalates. A human takes the
session, navigates back into the console, re-runs the lookup, reopens the
record -- and hands back. Replay then retries the step it failed on, on the
SAME session, with the sign-in and everything else still intact.
This is the point of the handoff being on a live session rather than a
fresh one: the operator does four steps, not twelve.
Interactively this is `--operator console` (type these commands yourself),
`--operator web` (a remote console with a live view of the session), or
`--operator takeover` (use the real browser window). The scripted channel
exists so the evidence in /evidence is reproducible.
notes: Operator navigated back into the console, re-ran the member lookup and reopened the record, then returned control to the automation.
